content: Boracic lint was a specific type of medical dressing created from surgical lint. This lint was immersed in a heated, saturated solution composed of boracic acid and glycerine. After being thoroughly soaked, it was allowed to dry before use. This medical dressing has been utilized since at least the 19th century, although its usage has significantly declined in modern times. The term boracic lint, or simply boracic, is pronounced as brassic. Interestingly, in Cockney rhyming slang, boracic is used as a colloquial expression to mean having no money, derived from the rhyme boracic lint -> skint.
